column3: NASB renders “we may cleanse” as “let us cleanse.”
NASB adds “in your hearts” and renders “exploited” as “took advantage of.”
NASB renders “For condemnation” as “to condemn you.”
NASB renders “being pressed” as “were afflicted.” A full-width colon appears in the NASB text.
NASB renders “grieved” as “caused … sorrow” and sets the middle of the verse off with dashes.
NASB renders “according to God” as “according to the will of God” and “grieved” as “made sorrowful.”
NASB follows the critical text (“produces”); “according to God” is rendered “according to the will of God,” and “grief” is “sorrow.”
NASB follows the critical text without “you” and “in”; it renders the list as “vindication of yourselves … avenging of wrong” and reorders it. A full-width colon appears in the NASB text.
NASB follows the critical text; it renders “the one having done wrong” as “the offender.”
NASB follows the critical text (“And besides our comfort”).
NASB renders “became truth” as “proved to be the truth.”
NASB renders “affections” as “affection” and adds “abounds” and “as he.”
NASB renders “I am confident in you” as “I have confidence in you.”
